            scores = priority_fn(
                item, np.array([remaining[i] for i in fit_idx], dtype=float)
            )
            chosen = fit_idx[int(np.argmax(scores))]
            remaining[chosen] -= item
        else:
            remaining.append(capacity - item)
    return len(remaining)
